description: This file implements an E2 network client factory for handling SCTP-based communication with E2 gateways, including classes for converting E2AP PDUs between packed and unpacked formats, establishing SCTP connections, and managing message forwarding.

classes.name: sctp_to_e2_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts packed E2AP PDUs from SCTP into unpacked format and forwards to E2 agent.

classes.name: e2_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts unpacked E2AP PDUs from E2 agent into packed format and forwards via SCTP.

classes.name: e2_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Manages SCTP connection to E2 gateway, handling message conversion and forwarding.

methods.name: handle_e2_connection_request
methods.description: Establishes SCTP connection and returns message notifier for E2 communication.
